title: Awesome cat lover subscription box!
text: I have been receiving the Pusheen subscription box since they started it and have always found something (or two or three or all!) in the box I like or love! For the items that are not really my thing, I always find someone who would enjoy them. I had another cat themed subscription box and cancelled it after the first one because I was so disappointed. Not with this one! Great for the cat lover in your life (or you)!
label: positive
